Pranab Mukherjee's PM Ambitions Revealed in Sonia Gandhi's Memoir

Former President Pranab Mukherjee had expressed a desire to become Prime Minister, a revelation that surprised Sonia Gandhi, according to her writings. Mukherjee reportedly wished to replace Manmohan Singh as Prime Minister. These details emerged from Sonia Gandhi's account, which has prompted questions from Sharmistha Mukherjee, daughter of Pranab Mukherjee, who expressed surprise at the revelation.
